title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Verification mail rate limit reset in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 -…
description: A vulnerability in the Joomla Extension 'vi-solutions' Visforms versions 1.0.0-5.6.4 and 6.0.0-6.2.1 causes the verification mail rate limit to reset on every form render. This flaw makes the rate limiting ineffective, potentially allowing excessive verification emails to be sent.
